## Kitsissut: Lethbridge Hut 1

This archaeological illustration documents the visible form and features of Lethbridge Hut 1 at Kitsissut based on UAV orthomosaic imagery.

[![](images/illustrations/lethbridge-hut-1-final.png){.static-preview .illustration-preview fig-alt="Completed archaeological illustration of Lethbridge Hut 1 at Kitsissut, based on UAV orthomosaic imagery"}](images/illustrations/lethbridge-hut-1-final.png){target="_blank"}

::: {.portfolio-actions}

[Open full-size completed illustration](images/illustrations/lethbridge-hut-1-final.png){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

:::

**My Role:** I used UAV orthomosaic imagery as a reference to draw the archaeological feature in Adobe Illustrator and produce a clear, finished vector illustration.

**Skills Demonstrated:** Adobe Illustrator, interpretation of UAV orthomosaic imagery, precise vector drawing, feature differentiation, visual hierarchy, labelling, and preparation of publication-quality archaeological graphics.

**Source and Context:** Produced from UAV orthomosaic imagery supplied by Dr. Matthew Walls as reference material for documenting archaeological features at Kitsissut.
